purpose: Durable research/Core/provenance sidecar for an issued Betting Edge report. The sidecar enriches immutable history, records production contract and Core authority used at issuance, and retains structured Core 1.4 model-error, Walters, personnel-sweep and WAIT-qualification evidence where applicable.

compatibility.rule: Schema-2 and previously issued schema-3 sidecars remain valid immutable historical evidence. Stage 2, WAIT qualification, Core 1.4 coreAssessment, waltersEvidence and Pinnacle observer provenance are additive forward-only extensions and do not require rewriting historical sidecars. Source/fair-value evidence is a forward-only additive extension from 2026-09-05T17:00:00-07:00; prior reports are not backfilled. Primary-analysis receipts and publisher coverage summaries apply from 2026-09-06T00:00:00-07:00; earlier issued records are not backfilled.

fields.label: issued report label
fields.reportPath: exact data/history/runs path of the stored issued payload
fields.feedGeneratedAt: exact feedGeneratedAt recorded in the issued payload

reportReference.rule: slot and ts must exactly match the issued payload; the sidecar never replaces the issued payload as authority.

fields.productionContractOperational: boolean; required post-cutover and must be true
fields.productionContractPath: string; required post-cutover and currently BETTING_EDGE_CONTRACT.md
fields.productionContractBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the authoritative production contract read before handicapping
fields.personnelSweepPath: string; required for new reports using the operational personnel process and currently BETTING_EDGE_PERSONNEL_SWEEP.md
fields.personnelSweepBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the operational personnel addendum resolved for the report
fields.runnerBlobSha: git blob SHA or null if unavailable
fields.feedBlobSha: git blob SHA of data/live-odds.json used for issuance or null if unavailable
fields.pinnacleObserverPath: data/oddspapi-observer.json when Pinnacle sharp context is available
fields.pinnacleObserverBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of data/oddspapi-observer.json consulted for the report, or null when unavailable/not consulted
fields.pinnacleGeneratedAt: exact generatedAt from the consulted Pinnacle observer snapshot, or null
fields.pinnacleStatus: observer status from the consulted snapshot, normally ok when eligible for use, or null
fields.pinnacleContextUsed: boolean; true only when an exact matched eligible Pinnacle observation materially informed at least one recommendation; false when consulted but not materially used
fields.researchLibraryBlobSha: git blob SHA of canonical research-library.json
fields.r2ValidationBlobSha: git blob SHA of the active R2 manual read test
fields.governanceDraftOperational: optional historical design provenance only; must not imply draft authority after production cutover
fields.governanceDraftBlobSha: optional exact Git blob SHA of historical design draft
fields.coreVersion: string; required for reports at/after the Core 1.4 cutover and currently 1.4
fields.coreProductionPath: string; required for Core 1.4 and currently core/core-v1.4-production.json
fields.coreProductionBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the operational Core 1.4 production manifest resolved before handicapping
fields.coreFrameworkPath: string; operational Core 1.4 model-error framework path
fields.coreFrameworkBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the Core 1.4 model-error framework used for the report
fields.waltersInterfacePath: string; operational Walters Core 1.4 interface path
fields.waltersInterfaceBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the Walters interface used for the report
fields.waltersAuthorityPath: string; runtime Walters authority config path
fields.waltersAuthorityBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the Walters authority config resolved for the report
fields.waltersMode: OFF|ADVISORY|BET_AUTHORITY; exact Walters mode resolved before handicapping

provenance.productionRule: New sidecars must preserve all existing production/Core/Research/Walters provenance requirements. When data/oddspapi-observer.json is consulted as Pinnacle sharp context, also record pinnacleObserverPath, exact pinnacleObserverBlobSha, pinnacleGeneratedAt, pinnacleStatus and pinnacleContextUsed. Pinnacle provenance is additive and does not make Pinnacle executable price authority or permit it to bypass Core gates. Historical sidecars remain valid and immutable.

recommendations.shape: array aligned to the issued recs by stable title/identity and ordinal

researchFitFields.grade: A|B|C|D|NR with optional +/- only for communication
researchFitFields.limitation: strongest caveat, conflict, era issue or research gap
researchFitFields.displayText: the concise History Fit wording placed in the issued report's existing hist field

stage2GateFields.personnelRequired: boolean required on every new recommendation after the Stage 2 publication-gate cutover; true when Stage 2 personnel work was material to the serious candidate or materially affects the final decision, including a personnel-driven PASS
stage2GateFields.rule: personnelRequired is the primary structured trigger for personnelEvidence. Recommendation wording that signals lineup, batting order, participation, role, minutes, starter, active/inactive or identity-context dependence is a conservative backstop and may not be used to mark personnelRequired=false to evade Stage 2 evidence.

waitQualification.requiredWhen: For new reports after the WAIT-qualification publication cutover, every recommendation whose final status is WAIT must include this record.

fields.actionableIfResolved: must be true; means the candidate has a plausible path to LEAN/BET or materially closer actionability if the named blockers clear under fresh re-handicapping
fields.blockers: non-empty array of the specific unresolved gates preventing action now
fields.independentSignals: non-empty array of current signals materially separate from the Bet365/DraftKings quote pair or market-derived no-vig calculation; each signal must contain origin and finding
fields.rationale: concise explanation of why the candidate merits WAIT rather than PASS despite the unresolved blockers

waitQualification.rule: A sportsbook outlier, cross-book price gap, positive market-derived no-vig residual, stale/missing comparison quote, or unresolved personnel fact does not by itself qualify a recommendation for WAIT. At least one current independent non-market signal must support the underlying handicap, and the recommendation must be plausibly actionable if its blockers clear. Bet365, DraftKings, Odds-API/live-feed rows, a two-book no-vig benchmark, or market consensus may not be recorded as the required independent signal. If these conditions are not met, use PASS with the appropriate fair-value-confidence, price-quality, information or identity reason.

personnelEvidence.requiredWhen: For new reports, include on a recommendation when personnelRequired=true. This includes Stage 2 personnel work material to a serious candidate or an unresolved personnel assumption materially affecting BET/LEAN/WAIT/PASS status, fair value, uncertainty or playTo. Historical sidecars are not backfilled.

fields.stage2CheckedAt: timestamp or lane-local date/time showing when the deep personnel sweep was performed
fields.dependencyTarget: the exact personnel dependency or dependencies verified as causally relevant to the wager, oriented to the correct team/opponent/participant/role
fields.dependencyRationale: concise explanation of why the dependency can materially affect this exact market/selection
fields.officialSources: array of authoritative source records checked for the material personnel facts; each record should carry origin, url, asOf and a specific fact/finding, and a Stage 2 closing authoritative check for a still-material unresolved dependency must set finalRecheck=true
fields.fallbackSources: array of distinct credible current fallback source records; every record must carry a non-empty canonical origin; when the official state remains unresolved, target 3 to 5 distinct fallback source origins where available
fields.fallbackSourceCount: integer count of distinct credible fallback source origins actually used/checked; must equal the fallbackSources array length after origin deduplication
fields.sourceShortfall: null or concise explanation when fewer than 3 credible current fallback sources genuinely exist after an event-specific search
fields.facts: array of material personnel facts found, with projected facts clearly distinguished from confirmed facts
fields.conflictSummary: null or concise description of the material disagreement among credible sources
fields.conflictResolution: null or concise rationale explaining why higher-quality, more direct or more current evidence resolves a conflict; required before STRONG PROJECTION when a material conflict had existed
fields.unresolved: array of material personnel questions that remain unresolved
fields.decisionSensitivity: specific plausible personnel outcome(s) that would materially change fair value, uncertainty, playTo or status; use NO MATERIAL PERSONNEL SENSITIVITY when none remains
fields.preStage2Fair: concise pre-sweep fair-value and/or uncertainty state
fields.postStage2Fair: concise post-sweep fair-value and/or uncertainty state
fields.decisionImpact: concise statement of how Stage 2 changed the decision, or NO MATERIAL CHANGE

officialSourceRecordFields.asOf: timestamp for the authoritative source check
officialSourceRecordFields.fact: specific dependency-relevant fact or finding, including an unresolved/not-yet-posted result when that is what the source shows
officialSourceRecordFields.finalRecheck: boolean; true only for the authoritative source check performed near Stage 2 close for a still-material unresolved personnel dependency

personnelEvidence.sourceCountRule: The 3-to-5 target counts distinct credible source origins, not URLs, mirrors or duplicated syndication. Each fallback source must carry a canonical origin. Duplicate normalized origins are rejected by the publication gate and do not count toward fallbackSourceCount. Do not add weak/stale sources to meet the count. If fewer than 3 exist, record sourceShortfall and preserve PARTIAL/UNKNOWN when appropriate.
personnelEvidence.dependencyRule: Personnel evidence must be tied to the actual causal dependency of the exact wager before it is used. Wrong-team, wrong-opponent or wrong-role dependencies must be corrected and researched again where necessary before final status.
personnelEvidence.finalRecheckRule: When a named personnel dependency remains materially unresolved at Stage 2 close, record a dependency-matching authoritative source check with finalRecheck=true before assigning final status. The authoritative source may still report unresolved, unavailable or not yet posted; the rule proves the closing check occurred and does not require a confirmed outcome.
personnelEvidence.conflictRule: A material unresolved source conflict prevents STRONG PROJECTION. Preserve PARTIAL/UNKNOWN and widen uncertainty unless a clear quality/directness/recency hierarchy resolves the disagreement and the resolution rationale is recorded.

coreAssessment.requiredWhen: Every recommendation in a report at/after the Core 1.4 cutover.

fields.frameworkId: must match the operational Core 1.4 framework ID
fields.context: structured fairValueBasis, bookDispersion, liquidityRisk, tailRisk, directCalibration, personnelSensitivity, independentCurrentSupport, sport/market/timing, movement flags and automatically applicable graduatedResearchIds
fields.fairValueBasisRationale: why the fair is independent, market-anchored, market-derived-only or unavailable
fields.betEligibleByModelError: boolean recomputed by the production Core 1.4 gate

coreAssessment.rule: The production gate recomputes modelErrorState and bet eligibility from the context and rejects forged/omitted applicable research rules. A BET may not publish when Core 1.4 recomputation blocks it. Pinnacle context cannot bypass or lower these gates.

waltersEvidence.requiredWhen: Every recommendation in a report at/after the Core 1.4 cutover; non-eligible markets record NOT_APPLICABLE. Eligible NFL spread/moneyline candidates resolve Walters availability whenever Walters mode is not OFF.
waltersEvidence.rule: BET_AUTHORITY may originate an eligible NFL spread/moneyline candidate, but the final recommendation must still pass Core 1.4 model-error and all normal Betting Edge hard gates. Walters is at most one independent handicap input.

sourceEvidence.requiredWhen: Every displayed card, including PASS; only a permitted explicit zero-stake PASS shortfall may use an empty array.
sourceEvidence.rule: Actual checked sources and findings bound to exact sport/event. Serious candidates require non-market evidence.

sourceShortfall.requiredWhen: PASS with empty sourceEvidence; not available to BET/LEAN/WAIT.
sourceShortfall.rule: Explain real missing evidence and its effect; never fabricate a fair or unsupported value conclusion.

fairValueEvidence.rule: Preserve actual numerical method and source-linked inputs. Estimate/result/display and range must agree in stated units/orientation. No new model or threshold is introduced. Material personnel retains the existing Stage 2 evidence.

benchmarkComparison.rule: edgeProbabilityPoints = 100 * (benchmarkNoVigProbability - executableImpliedProbability). This is benchmark comparison, not independent Core edge or BET authority.

sourceAndFairEvidence.validationLimit: Checks structure, identities and numeric consistency without fetching sources or proving source truth/model quality; author remains responsible for the actual research.

failureBehavior.researchUnavailable: Use HISTORY LIBRARY UNAVAILABLE in the issued hist field as appropriate and do not fabricate prior IDs.
failureBehavior.pinnacleUnavailable: Continue with the normal Bet365/DraftKings/Core process; record Pinnacle as unavailable/not used and do not fabricate sharp context.
failureBehavior.sidecarSaveFailure: Deliver the already-validated issued report and surface HISTORY SAVE FAILED — REPORT VALID; do not rebuild or mutate the report solely for sidecar storage.

fields.receipts: one exact-quote receipt for every available logical primary selection

primaryAnalysis.evaluated: state=EVALUATED, checkedAt, decision using full existing recommendation fields, evidence using matching sidecar fields; actual sources, numeric fair/range including PASS, recomputed Core assessment and required personnel evidence
primaryAnalysis.blocked: state=BLOCKED, blocker with controlled reason, concrete missing evidence, impact, checkedAt and actual event-specific attempts (eventId,checkedAt,url,finding); no decision or invented fair
primaryAnalysis.arithmetic: primary.evaluated + primary.blocked = primary.available; primary.available + primary.unavailable = primary.required. Totals add primaryAvailable and primaryBlocked. gamesEvaluated remains legacy inventory accounting.
primaryAnalysis.curation: All actionable decisions match published cards. Curated PASS decisions remain in receipts. Unavailable continuity PASS resolutions retain existing gates and do not receive evaluation credit.
primaryAnalysis.authority: Existing coverage and bundle gates validate receipts and pinned Core framework; structured checks cannot prove source truth or handicap quality.

publisherCoverageSummary.rule: Publisher derives and verifies exact available/evaluated/blocked/unavailable counts, actual decision counts, research blockers, bound acquisition explanations and separately identified discovery omissions. Card counters remain published-card counts. Historical payloads remain immutable.
